content.short: Neptune Finance is a collateral-based lending protocol on Injective using a dynamic PID interest rate model.
content.description:
Neptune Finance is a professional-grade decentralized lending and borrowing platform built natively on the Injective blockchain. The protocol allows users to supply various assets to earn interest and borrow against them in a transparent, non-custodial environment. A standout feature of Neptune is its unique PID controller interest rate model, which dynamically adjusts rates based on market utilization to ensure the most competitive pricing for both lenders and borrowers.

Designed for high scalability and sub-second execution, Neptune Finance provides the essential financial infrastructure needed for sophisticated DeFi participation on Injective. The platform is powered by the NEPT token, which facilitates governance and incentive coordination within the community. By combining institutional-grade risk management with the high-speed rails of the Injective network, Neptune is empowering users to build and manage diversified decentralized portfolios with unparalleled efficiency and transparency.
content.meta: Neptune Finance provides decentralized lending and high-speed credit facilities on the Injective blockchain.
